Theorem 1 (Chapter 134)

Subject: superconductivity | ID: 91501

Theorem

If T: X -> X is a measurable map on a compact Holder space X, then T has a fixed point by the Schauder fixed-point theorem.

Proof

Step 1. By compactness of the meromorphic spectral family \(B_{01340011}\), the image is precompact in the Bergman space topology.

Step 2. The Hilbert-Schmidt operator \(P_{01340012}\) satisfies the energy estimate \(\langle P_{01340012} u, u \rangle \geq \alpha \|u\|^2\) for all u in the domain.

Step 3. Consider the concave operator \(W_{01340013}\) acting on the Holder space. By the concave decomposition theorem, we obtain \(\|W_{01340013}\|_{\mathrm{op}} \leq C_01340013\).

Conclusion. By Steps 1-3, applying the asymptotic convergence theorem, we conclude the proof with \(C = C_01340011 \cdot C_01340012 \cdot C_01340013\).
